name: Finger Lakes

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Riesling sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.
keyfacts: Finger Lakes is an AVA in upstate New York, set up in 1982.
Vineyards close to the lakes stay cooler in spring, which delays bud break and protects against spring frost, and in fall the lakes add some heat to nearby vines.
The region is known as one of the finest cool-climate growing areas in North America, especially for Riesling.
Growers plant European Vitis vinifera, native American Vitis labrusca and French-American hybrid grapes.
Cayuga Lake and Seneca Lake were set up as sub-appellations, in 1988 and 2003 respectively.

blurb.text: An upstate New York AVA south of Lake Ontario. It contains the Cayuga Lake and Seneca Lake AVAs. In Yates, Seneca, Schuyler and Ontario Counties, Riesling is the most planted wine grape, just ahead of Catawba.
